limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses mouse models; findings may not fully translate to human AD.
The study focuses on pre-plaque stages; later stages may involve additional mechanisms.
The study does not address the role of other complement components beyond C1q, C3, and CR3.

missed_core_items.description: The study used super-resolution structured illumination microscopy (SIM) to quantify synapse density in hippocampal CA1 stratum radiatum of J20 mice.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: To determine how early synapse loss occurs, we used super-resolution structured illumination microscopy (SIM) (10) to quantify synapse density in hippocampal CA1 stratum radiatum of familial AD-mutant hAPP (“J20”) transgenic mice (11).

missed_core_items.description: Synapse loss was confirmed using electron microscopy in pre-plaque J20 CA1.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Synapse loss in pre-plaque J20 CA1 was confirmed using electron microscopy (Fig. S1G).

missed_core_items.description: C1q immunoreactivity was elevated in J20 brains as early as 1 month, preceding synapse loss.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: C1q immunoreactivity (13; antibody now available at Abcam) was elevated in J20 brains, as early as 1 mo and preceding synapse loss (Fig. 1B and fig. S1).

missed_core_items.description: C1q elevation was region-specific, particularly in hippocampus and frontal cortex.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: C1q elevation was region-specific, particularly in hippocampus and frontal cortex, two regions vulnerable to synapse loss (14) (Fig. 1B and fig. S2A).

missed_core_items.description: C1q was also increased in hippocampus of APP/PS1 mice.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: C1q was also similarly increased in hippocampus of another model of AD, the APP/PS1 mice (15) (Fig. S2C).

missed_core_items.description: SIM demonstrated colocalization of C1q with PSD95-positive puncta in 1-month J20 hippocampus.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Importantly, SIM demonstrated colocalization of C1q with PSD95-positive puncta in 1 mo J20 hippocampus (Fig. 1C).

missed_core_items.description: A higher percentage of PSD95 colocalized with C1q in hippocampus of J20 mice than WT.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: A higher percentage of PSD95 colocalized with C1q in hippocampus of J20 mice than that of WT (Fig. 1D and fig. S3), suggesting that the C1q-associated synapses may be marked for elimination.

missed_core_items.description: Punctate Aβ was found deposited in J20 hippocampus at 1 month, long before Aβ plaques deposit.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Punctate Aβ was found deposited in J20 hippocampus at 1 mo (Fig. S4), long before Aβ plaques deposit (11, 12), raising the question of whether C1q increase in these pre-plaque brains is dependent on soluble Aβ levels.

missed_core_items.description: Compound E, a γ-secretase inhibitor, reduced soluble Aβ levels and correspondingly reduced C1q deposition in J20 mice.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Compound E markedly reduced soluble Aβ levels in J20 mice; there was a corresponding reduction of C1q deposition (Fig. 1E), suggesting that Aβ upregulates C1q.

missed_core_items.description: Oligomeric Aβ, but not monomeric Aβ or vehicle, induced C1q deposition in WT mice.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Oligomeric Aβ (oAβ), which is prefibrillar in nature and acts as a mediator of synapse loss and dysfunction in AD (4), but not the relatively innocuous monomeric Aβ or vehicle, induced C1q deposition (Fig. 2A and fig. S5).

missed_core_items.description: A higher percentage of PSD95 colocalized with C1q in oAβ-injected mice vs. monomer-injected.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: A higher percentage of PSD95 colocalized with C1q in oAβ-injected mice vs. monomer-injected (Fig. 2B), in a manner similar to this colocalization in J20 mice.

missed_core_items.description: Fluorescent in situ hybridization demonstrated upregulated C1qa expression in microglia.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Furthermore, fluorescent in situ hybridization demonstrated upregulated C1qa expression in microglia (Fig. S6), implicating microglia as a major source of C1q in these pre-plaque brains.

missed_core_items.description: oAβ induced significant C3 deposition in WT adult mice, which was reduced in C1qa KO and ANX-M1-treated mice.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: However, oAβ induced a significant C3 deposition in WT adult mice (Fig. S7A, upper panel). This was significantly reduced in both the C1qa KO (Fig. S7A, lower panel) and the ANX-M1 C1q antibody-treated WT mice (fig. S7B), suggesting that the C3 deposition in this model is downstream of the classical complement cascade.

missed_core_items.description: A higher percentage of PSD95 colocalized with C3 in J20 and APP/PS1 brains.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Consistent with these findings, a higher percentage of PSD95 colocalized with C3 in J20 and APP/PS1 brains (Fig. 3D and fig. S9).

missed_core_items.description: Microglia had elevated levels of CD68 in J20 hippocampus compared to WT, and less so in striatum.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Consistent with this hypothesis, microglia had elevated levels of the lysosomal protein CD68 in J20 hippocampus compared to WT, and less so in striatum, a less vulnerable region (Fig. S1C and fig. S10).

missed_core_items.description: In WT mice challenged with oAβ, microglia had significantly increased levels of CD68 immunoreactivity.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Furthermore, in WT mice challenged with oAβ, microglia had significantly increased levels of CD68 immunoreactivity (Fig. 2C).

missed_core_items.description: In C1qa KO mice, oAβ failed to induce an increase in CD68.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: However, in C1qa KO mice in which synapse loss was rescued, oAβ failed to induce such an increase (Fig. 2D), suggesting that microglia eliminate synapses through the complement pathway.

missed_core_items.description: Internalized Homer-GFP often colocalized with CD68, suggesting engulfed synapses are internalized into lysosomal compartments.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Internalized Homer-GFP often colocalized with CD68 (Fig. S11A), suggesting that the engulfed synapses are internalized into lysosomal compartments in a manner similar to developmental synaptic pruning (6).

missed_core_items.description: All CR3-positive microglia were P2RY12-positive, indicating they are resident cells.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: All CR3-positive microglia were P2RY12-positive (Fig. S11), indicating they are resident cells (22).
